title: Sharp supply-chain gate blocked every cf:* deploy path
root_cause: EXPECTED_DEPENDENCY_PATHS/EXPECTED_PROVENANCE pinned Next 16.2.11 + Wrangler 4.113.0 + miniflare 4.20260721.0/sharp 0.34.5; the committed lockfile installs Next 16.2.12 + Wrangler 4.115.0 + miniflare 4.20260722.1/sharp 0.35.2
entrypoint: npm run cf:deploy:production / cf:dry-run / cf:preview / cf:upload
reproduction: check-sharp-risk.mjs deployment production AND deployment preview both exit 1 with 5 provenance errors
focused_verification: audit-exception exit 0; deployment gate preview+production exit 0; gate self-tests 27/27
full_verification: npm run cf:dry-run exit 0 end to end; Worker 6791.21 KiB gzip
production_impact: Production could not be released at all
notes: Root cause of the silent drift: the gate's own suite validates a SYNTHETIC lockfile fixture and nothing in npm run check reads the real package-lock.json

title: A single accepted advisory skips every build and Worker verification job in CI
root_cause: Security Checks runs `npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level high` with no exemption for the formally accepted sharp risk (BA-0044); build + cloudflare-build both `needs: [test, security]`
sink: Production Build, Cloudflare Worker Build and Lighthouse all skipped
reproduction: gh run view 30513673331: Security Checks failure; Production Build skipped; Cloudflare Worker Build skipped; Lighthouse skipped
focused_verification: Confirmed against runs 30513673331 (1301734f) and 30512740454 (6d9a3ac9) - both red on npm audit only
production_impact: No build or Worker verification has run in CI since the advisory appeared, so the RTA-0001 deploy breakage was invisible to CI
deployment_requirement: Owner must decide CI advisory policy
deferred_reason: Deciding which advisories CI may tolerate is a security-policy call; changing it unilaterally would read as weakening a gate
owner_decision: Express the accepted sharp exception in CI (or decouple build jobs from the advisory gate) so new advisories still fail but accepted ones do not blind the pipeline
notes: postcss bump in 46c0d4ed removed 2 of the 5 advisories but does NOT turn this green - the sharp set remains

title: push-reminders cron route has no scheduler; deadline reminders cannot fire
root_cause: BA-0016 removed the GitHub Actions schedule trigger (correctly - it was an unreconciled fourth scheduler whose secrets were unset) but the route was never adopted into the Cloudflare triggers, which carry only the three cleanup expressions
reproduction: wrangler.jsonc production triggers.crons = 3 cleanup expressions only; CRON_ROUTE_BY_EXPRESSION maps the same 3; gh run list --workflow=push-reminders-cron.yml: 0 successes in last 300 runs, all failures, schedule trigger now removed
fix_commit: d7036029 (gap pinned as a test invariant; not enabled)
production_impact: Push/deadline reminder notifications do not fire in production. The route's own batch cap documents a 10-minute cadence it no longer has for catch-up after truncation
deferred_reason: Wiring a trigger resumes real push delivery to real users; audit brief §2.4 puts scheduled-trigger changes outside a code-only pass
owner_decision: Add '*/10 * * * *' -> /api/cron/push-reminders to CRON_ROUTE_BY_EXPRESSION and wrangler.jsonc production triggers
notes: Encoded as an explicit KNOWN_UNSCHEDULED exception carrying its reason, so any NEW cron-authenticated route added without an owner fails the suite

title: Password-reset and email-verify tokens were double-spendable under a race
root_cause: Consuming UPDATE did not check the affected row count; PostgREST reports a zero-row UPDATE as success (error: null), so the loser of a race proceeded to the privileged write
reproduction: Both zero-row cases failed 'expected 200 to be 400' against the old code, i.e. the routes performed the privileged write for the loser
focused_verification: 4 new tests pass; tests/api/auth 11 files / 40 tests pass
production_impact: A single-use recovery token could be spent twice
notes: Carried from 2026-07-22 as BA-0006 status `candidate`; confirmed in both routes and closed. passwordReset.test.ts fixture updated (contract change, assertion unchanged)

title: WebAuthn RP ID and expected origin failed OPEN to client-controlled headers
root_cause: Both resolvers fell back to the request's own Host/Origin when the env anchor was missing, making the origin check compare an attacker-supplied value against itself
reproduction: Static: both resolvers returned header-derived values with the env unset. Latency of exploit depends on process.env being empty, which BA-0017 proves is possible on Workers
full_verification: 146 files / 1285 tests pass; typecheck + typecheck:cloudflare exit 0
production_impact: Latent, not live - production sets both anchors. Becomes live under a BA-0017-style empty process.env isolate
notes: Carried from 2026-07-22 as BA-0003 status `validated`, never fixed. Whitespace-only now treated as missing

title: HIBP breach lookup was unbounded and could hang signup and password reset
root_cause: fetch had no timeout and no abort signal, so the documented fail-open covered a dependency that FAILS but not one that HANGS
reproduction: With the signal removed the hang test dies with 'Test timed out in 10000ms', reproducing the stall rather than asserting a shape
production_impact: A hanging third party could stall account creation and password reset until the platform killed the request
notes: Found by inventorying every outbound host and checking each caller for a timeout/abort path - this was the one with neither in front of account creation

title: postcss pinned to a version affected by two high advisories
root_cause: An overrides.next.postcss entry (17b1fe11) pinned 8.5.10; the advisories (GHSA-6g55-p6wh-862q, GHSA-r28c-9q8g-f849) are fixed in 8.5.18. npm's proposed remedy was a next@14 major DOWNGRADE, so the 2026-07-22 audit filed it as unreachable and moved on
reproduction: npm audit reported 5 high; postcss accounted for 2
regression_test: none added (advisory count is asserted by no test)
focused_verification: postcss resolves 8.5.25; npm audit 5 high -> 4 high; Sharp gate exit 0; gate self-tests 27/27
full_verification: 147 files / 1289 tests pass; npm run build compiled; CSS output verified non-empty (250 KB, MQ tokens, Tailwind utilities, autoprefixer output)
production_impact: Build-time only; not reachable at runtime
notes: Remaining 4 advisories are one root cause: sharp/libvips via Next's OPTIONAL image dependency, governed by the reachability gate

title: Password reset does not revoke the user's other sessions
root_cause: Password *change* revokes via auth.signOut({scope:'others'}) (BA-0005) but reset runs unauthenticated, and admin.signOut in @supabase/auth-js 2.104.1 requires the user's JWT which that path never has
reproduction: Static: no revocation call in the reset path; confirmed admin API surface offers only signOut(jwt, scope)
production_impact: An attacker's session survives the recovery that was meant to evict it - and reset is the mechanism used precisely when compromise is suspected
deferred_reason: Closing it requires a SECURITY DEFINER function over auth.refresh_tokens (a migration) or a GoTrue-level change; out of scope for a code-only pass and migrations must not be applied to production in this audit
owner_decision: Add a definer function to revoke refresh tokens by user id, or adopt a GoTrue version exposing admin logout by user id
notes: BA-0005 was marked fixed_targeted for the change path only; this is the residual and it is the more security-relevant of the two

title: Webmanifest served a doubled Content-Type
root_cause: public/_headers declared Content-Type for /manifest.webmanifest twice - an exact-path rule and a /*.webmanifest glob - and Cloudflare applies every matching rule and appends
reproduction: Verified live: curl -sSI https://www.syllabus-sync.app/manifest.webmanifest returns the comma-joined value
focused_verification: 8 tests pass; reintroducing the rule fails with 'set by 2 rules'
production_impact: A comma-joined Content-Type is not a valid media type; a browser may reject it, costing PWA installability
deployment_requirement: Deploy required - _headers ships with the assets
notes: Root cause for the 2026-07-29 'doubled Content-Type, root cause unidentified' follow-up. Cannot be confirmed live until deployed

title: Eleven SECURITY DEFINER functions have no pinned search_path
root_cause: Their current definitions omit SET search_path, and the migration chain contains no ALTER FUNCTION ... SET search_path anywhere to supply it later
sink: definer-privileged execution with a mutable resolution path
affected_files: supabase/migrations (add_sample_class_times, handle_new_user_profile, on_deadline_completed, protect_profile_fields, handle_new_user_gamification, soft_delete, purge_deleted_records, refresh_analytics_views, seed_demo_events, audit_trigger, cleanup_expired_webauthn_challenges)
reproduction: Static over the full ordered chain, keeping only each function's LAST definition; verified no ALTER FUNCTION ... SET search_path exists in any migration
production_impact: Defence-in-depth. Exploitation needs CREATE on a schema earlier in the resolution path, which Supabase revokes from PUBLIC by default - so not demonstrated live
deployment_requirement: Confirm against the live catalogue then pin
deferred_reason: Requires a migration; live catalogue state was not queried in this pass, and several are trigger functions where a bad pin changes behaviour
owner_decision: Pin search_path on each; several are triggers (handle_new_user_profile
column23: protect_profile_fields) which is the classic hijack shape
column25: Violates the repo's own stated rule that SECURITY DEFINER functions must pin search_path

title: pg_cron duplicates two Cloudflare cleanup crons at identical minutes
root_cause: Migrations register pg_cron jobs at '0 3 * * *' and '10 3 * * *' - the exact expressions Cloudflare uses for /api/auth/email/cleanup and /api/auth/password/cleanup
reproduction: Static: cron.schedule expressions compared against wrangler.jsonc production triggers
production_impact: Low - both sides issue idempotent DELETEs of expired rows. But a green Cloudflare cron is not evidence the cleanup ran, and the two contend at the same minute
deployment_requirement: Confirm pg_cron is installed on the live project
deferred_reason: Requires a read-only live catalogue query that was not performed; if pg_cron is absent the finding is moot
owner_decision: Unschedule the two duplicated pg_cron jobs or drop the Cloudflare triggers; keep cleanup-webauthn-challenges (pg_cron only)
notes: Carried from 2026-07-22 as BA-0011 status `validated`. cleanup-webauthn-challenges at */15 is NOT duplicated

title: npm run check omits the deploy-blocking gates
root_cause: `check` runs secrets -> cloudflare-runtime -> format -> typecheck x2 -> lint -> test -> build, but not security:sharp:audit-exception or check:worker-size
sink: green check with a broken deploy path
reproduction: Baseline: npm run check exit 0 while check-sharp-risk.mjs audit-exception exited 1
production_impact: The headline gate reported healthy while production was undeployable
review_expiry: Consider adding security:sharp:audit-exception to `check`; worker-size needs a build log so it fits cf:dry-run better
column23: Partially mitigated: the new provenance test runs inside npm run check, so this specific drift now fails there

title: .prettierignore excludes all security source from the formatting gate
root_cause: A bare `security` pattern matches any path segment of that name, so lib/security/, tests/security/, app/api/security/ and docs/security/ are all exempt
reproduction: npx prettier --check lib/security/password-breach.ts passes despite the file using double quotes where the repo uses single
production_impact: None directly. But the most security-sensitive directory is the one the formatting gate cannot see, and style drift there goes unreviewed
review_expiry: Scope the pattern (e.g. docs/security) rather than leaving it bare
column23: Deliberately NOT fixed: narrowing it would reformat many files at once, which the brief forbids. Explains the double/single quote split in lib/security/

title: Twenty-one API routes authenticate inline instead of via the mandated guard
root_cause: Routes call supabase.auth.getUser() directly rather than wrapping in requireAuth / requireAuthWithRateLimit / withApiGuard as AGENT.md §1 requires
reproduction: Generated from source: 16 requireAuthWithRateLimit, 5 requireAuth, 21 inline getUser(), 26 none (public allowlist or page routes)
production_impact: Layer-2 CSRF and rate-limit wrapping is skipped; edge middleware still performs CSRF origin validation, so this is defence-in-depth not an open hole. Most carry a named limiter already
review_expiry: Migrate to the guard wrappers incrementally; several already call a limiter manually
column23: None of the 26 'no guard' routes is a genuine gap - all are intentionally unauthenticated endpoints or page routes

title: Two parallel passkey stacks with divergent middleware posture
root_cause: /api/auth/passkey/* is inside the `/api/auth/` public allowlist so it is exempt from BOTH deny-by-default and the middleware AAL2 gate; /api/webauthn/register/* is not on the allowlist and gets both
reproduction: Static: the AAL gate condition is `isProtectedRoute || isAuthRoute || (isApiRoute && !isPublicApi)`, and /api/auth/ matches isPublicApiPath
production_impact: Passkey enrolment via the /api/auth/passkey/* stack does not require AAL2. Both stacks still verify the session inline
review_expiry: Consolidate onto one stack; until then decide whether passkey enrolment must require AAL2
column23: Confirms the second half of BA-0004 (status `candidate`). lib/constants/config.ts references both stacks

title: Dev-only pin editor ships fs into the Worker bundle
root_cause: app/api/maps/dev-pin/route.ts statically imports node:fs and sets runtime='nodejs' for a feature guarded by NODE_ENV !== 'development'
reproduction: Static: guard returns 403 before touching fs, so unreachable in production, but the module is still bundled
production_impact: None - fails closed. Costs Worker bundle size, which is 6791 KiB gzip against a near-ceiling budget, and adds needless attack surface
review_expiry: Exclude dev-only routes from production builds
column23: Guard itself is correct - checked and it returns 403 before any fs call

title: Apex domain still served by Vercel
root_cause: Apex was never migrated during the 2026-07-29 cutover
reproduction: curl -sSI https://syllabus-sync.app/ returns HTTP/2 308 with `server: Vercel`
production_impact: None today - it 308s to www correctly. Becomes an outage the moment Vercel is decommissioned
review_expiry: Move the apex to Cloudflare before retiring Vercel
column23: Pre-existing follow-up from the cutover record, re-confirmed live in this pass
